description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash FFN monokernel steps on a TP4 group: rows = decode requests, or DSpark verify requests x 8 (8 rows a request), at the compiled widths 1-16. The kernel reads no KV cache, so its work does not depend on the context. Row weights from the AgentX corpus (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126) in-flight request distribution at concurrency 1, 2, 4 and 8, decode and DSpark serving weighted equally; derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture (the checkpoint is not on the cluster). Production-range span exemption: the model fixes every other dimension and the served rows span 16x (workload_evidence.json). rows = 1 is the minimum and rows = 5 the non-power-of-two boundary case; both are also timed. Four row counts (four FlyDSL builds) keep the evaluation inside its budget.

cases.source: decode of 1 request (AgentX C1: R = 1 in 90.0% of steps); row weight 15.7%; the minimum width
decode of 5 requests (C4: R = 5 in 15.8% of steps; C2: 1.8%); row weight 3.2%; the non-power-of-two boundary
DSpark verify of 1 request x 8 rows (C1: R = 1 in 90.0% of steps) and decode of 8 requests (C8: R = 8 in 43.1%); row weight 23.8%
DSpark verify of 2 requests x 8 rows (C2: R = 2 in 81.0% of steps; C1: 5.4%) and decode of 16 requests; row weight 15.3%; the largest width
